DIRECT NOTICE TO PARENTS AND REQUEST FOR CONSENT

Larkmoor Learning, Inc. — Sprout Reading Club

Why you are receiving this notice

Your child has asked to create an account on Sprout Reading Club. Because Sprout is directed to children under 13, the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act requires us to tell you what we collect from your child and to obtain your verifiable consent before we collect it.

What we want to collect from your child

First name, a username you and your child choose together, a parent email address (yours), your child's grade level, and the books your child marks as read. If your child uses the read-aloud feature, we process a short audio recording of your child's voice on the device and send only a score to us; the recording is deleted on the device immediately and is never transmitted.

How we use it

To create and maintain the account, to recommend books at the right reading level, to show your child's progress to you, and to keep the service secure. We do not use your child's information for behavioral advertising, and we do not permit any third party to do so.

Who we disclose it to

Our hosting provider, Nimbus Hosting GmbH, and our reading-assessment provider, Halvard Literacy AB, each of which processes the information only on our instructions and is contractually forbidden to use it for any other purpose. We do not disclose your child's information to anyone else, and we do not sell it.

How long we keep it

For as long as the account is active, and for 90 days after you or your child closes it, after which we delete it. We retain your child's information only as long as is reasonably necessary to fulfill the purpose it was collected for.

Your child does not have to give us more than is necessary

We do not condition your child's participation in any activity on your child disclosing more personal information than is reasonably necessary to take part in that activity.

Your rights as a parent

You may review the personal information we have collected from your child, you may refuse to permit its further collection or use, and you may direct us to delete it. To do any of those, email parents@larkmoorlearning.com or write to Larkmoor Learning, Inc., Attn: Privacy, 40 Bevis Marks, Providence, Rhode Island 02903, or call (401) 555-0138. We will need to verify that you are the parent before we act.

How to give or refuse consent

Reply to this email with the word CONSENT, or complete the consent form at larkmoorlearning.com/parent-consent, where you will be asked to verify your identity by a government-issued identification check or a small refundable charge to a payment card.

If we do not receive your consent within 14 days, we will delete the information we collected from your child in order to send you this notice, and the account will not be created.

Effective: March 1, 2026. Our full privacy policy is at larkmoorlearning.com/privacy.
